plan.design_markdown:
# GB-110: Neurosymbolic Engine & Grammar Documentation Overhaul (Dado, Batten, Joiner)

## Architectural Directives & Mandatory Exemplar
1. **Mandatory Exemplar Requirement:** The implementing agent MUST read and align with `miter/README.md` and `miter/AGENTS.md` as the gold standard. Every repository document set must deliver matching depth:
   - `README.md`: Woodworking metaphor, badges, "Why X?" without/with tables, real console walkthroughs, complete CLI/MCP references.
   - `PRODUCT.md`: Distinct user personas, acute friction points, JTBD, telemetry metrics.
   - `ARCHITECTURE.md`: High-density Mermaid diagrams, crate boundaries, storage/runtime pipelines, cross-tool contracts.
   - `SPEC.md`: Formal behavioral invariants, state machines, algebraic wire types, CLI grammar/exit codes.
   - `DESIGN.md`: Minimum 3 concrete ADRs with Context, Decision, Consequences, and Rejected Alternatives.
   - `AGENTS.md`: Full non-negotiable engineering laws (hard 250 LOC, zero inline scope creep with `storypole defer`, Tiered Verification Gates, conventional commits, branch isolation) plus domain-specific invariant rules.
   - `CONTRIBUTING.md`: Precise Rust 2024 toolchain, inner loop commands, clippy/fmt rules.
   - `ROADMAP.md`: Active beta lifecycle status, completed milestones, future horizons mapped to Storypole.
   - `CHANGELOG.md`: Strict Keep a Changelog with active `[Unreleased]`.

## Phased Execution Steps
1. `gb-111-dado-docs` | Elevate dado across all 9 canonical docs (polyglot AST patterns, typed holes `?[id: Type]`, structural mixins, Tree-sitter splicing) | `chalkline docs check -d dado`
2. `gb-112-batten-docs` | Elevate batten across all 9 canonical docs (dynamic scope to CFG compiler, GBNF/Lark token masking, state machines) | `chalkline docs check -d batten`
3. `gb-113-joiner-docs` | Elevate joiner across all 9 canonical docs (master neurosymbolic loop, System 1/2 routing, compiler error feedback repair loop) | `chalkline docs check -d joiner`
